post.description: Get or create a document and return only essential document information for UI.

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("localhost:8080")

payload = "{\"item_id\":\"string\",\"item_type\":\"string\",\"attachment_id\":\"string\",\"attachment_source\":\"string\",\"internal_pdm_tool_data\":{\"file_key\":\"string\",\"file_format\":\"string\",\"file_locked\":true,\"document_container_id\":\"string\",\"position_within_container\":\"string\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/viewer_documents/get_or_create", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

get.description: Resolve the absolute document-viewer URL for a viewer document and redirect to it. Classic tools (Documents, Specifications, Drawings) are resolved to their prostore file; Document Management revisions are addressed by revision id. The host comes from the configured viewer host. Pass redirect=false to receive the URL as JSON instead of a 302.

parameters.name: viewer_doc_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the viewer document

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: When true (default), respond with a 302 redirect to the viewer URL

parameters.name: issue_id
parameters.description: Related item issue id; when present the viewer URL opens the related items panel for it

302.description: Redirect to the viewer URL or the login page
